No worries — getting started with Nurosym is pretty simple. Here’s the easiest way to begin:
Put a little moisture on the tragus (the small bump on your ear).
Clip the earpiece to your left ear, with the cable going over and behind your ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the energy until you feel a light, pleasant tingling in your ear. 
Then just go about your day — you can read, work, meditate, or relax while it runs.
